content_zh:
第一卷 荒原的奇迹 FS017 山地摩托车赛季构想
罪恶之都西方六百飞轮，一栋两层楼的现代化别墅坐落在半山之间。
二楼的阳台上，文森半躺在躺椅上，他的身前，一个紫色光球浮现。这个光球，如同全息投影一般，光球中，一座栩栩如生的城市出现。
文森手指在光球上翻动，点击，光球图像随即放大，城市局部详细图出现，并且还有附带的建筑图。
这个光球，是结合了炼金术、魔纹术，以及建筑学知识制造的。其中建筑学的知识，当然是来自罪恶之都的建筑大师团队了！
“克索斯管家，罪恶之都的人员到齐没有？”文森收起光球递给克索斯问道。
克索斯一身黑袍，右手提着一根一米多长的法杖，法杖顶端不时闪过几丝电花，身上的气势比之才恢复那时，又要浓烈几分。
“文森少爷，罪恶之都的法师、战士人员基本到齐，还剩一些普通民众正在迁徙途中。我已经安排一个大魔导师和一个大战师带领了一些职业人员随行，确保普通民众安全。另外，土系法师已经在建立城市地基和地下管网部分。”克索斯拿着一张列表，一一汇报道。
“对了，文森少爷，建设城市地下管网，我们发现了暗黑精灵一族。您把暗黑魔龙收服之后，他们又回到了地下城。不过，他们见到我们就匆匆撤离，并没有发生冲突。”
“另外，我们在改造荒山的时候，抓住了一个灰矮人。”克索斯看了一眼文森，见他没有任何表示，接着道：“文森少爷您吩咐的荒山改造，经过了七天时间，已经接近完成，只剩下最后一些细节问题。”
“噢？这么快？”文森心中感叹，魔法力量在有些地方果然超越了科技力量。
比如这次的荒山改造，他打算从荒山底端，环绕山间修建公路。如果如同科技社会那般，这绝对是一项宏大的工程。
但是，魔法力量中的土系魔法师却能够快速完成修建公路的任务。
土系魔法中，有专门平整路面，坚实路面的魔法，而且发展了几万年，土系魔法师修路的本领十分高强！
全长两百飞轮的山间路，只用了短短一周时间！
这条山间路是文森用来发展城市的一个重要构想。克伦蒂亚世界的魔法科技十分落后，几乎算是原始阶段。
文森恰好又在这些荒山山脉中发现了一种特殊的绝魔金属，因此产生了一个奇妙的想法，在异界举办一个山地摩托车赛事。
并且，将山地摩托车比赛发展成为一种年年举办的活动，如同前世科技社会中那样的年度盛事！
“文森少爷，因为只需要修建道路，并不需要其他建筑，因此，魔法师们修建的速度十分快。不过，文森少爷，恕老仆问一句，那座荒山上面什么都没有，根本不会有人去，修路干什么？”克索斯终于忍不住心中的疑问，开口问道。
文森看向那座隐藏有绝魔金属的山峰，露出神秘的微笑，“克索斯管家，过一段时间，你会知道的！”

“可是....”克索斯还待再问。
“好了，克索斯管家！”文森从躺椅上站起，走到护栏旁边，趴在护栏上，看着不远处正在建设的城市。
“克索斯管家，你相信奇迹吗？”文森不经意间的问道。
克索斯想了想，“文森少爷，那您相信奇迹吗？”
“哈哈哈哈！”文森大笑起来。
指着正在建设的城市，一脸自信道：“克索斯管家，我不相信！”
顿了顿，他身上突然涌出一股惊天的意境，“但是，我会创造奇迹！”
“克索斯管家，我们的城市就叫做——奇迹之城！”
“奇迹之城....奇迹之城....”克索斯喃了两句，脑中不断回想起遇见文森后的一切。首先便是他自己恢复了魔力，然后是逼迫了神话级强者退步，如今在荒野平原建立城市，这一切的一切不正是奇迹吗？
想着想着，克索斯突然觉得自己仿佛年轻了几十岁，充满了激情干劲，想要见证一座城市的崛起，想要随奇迹之城一起写入史诗，想要随着奇迹之城演绎一部万古流芳的传奇！
“奇迹之城！”克索斯大声道。
文森微笑的看了他一眼，转头看向奇迹之城。他知道，从今之后，克索斯将完完全全的与奇迹之城联系在了一起，与他联系在了一起，会成为他一辈子的管家。
“克索斯管家，那个灰矮人是干什么的？”魔武世界中，有矮人这个种族，这个种族的特点是矮小精壮，对于锻造十分有心得。
克索斯带着兴奋与期待的笑容，回答道：“灰矮人是矮人族的分支，灰矮人由于体质是暗黑属性的原因，对于锻造并不在行，久而久之，便脱离了矮人种族，独立成为一个种族。不过由于灰矮人对于挖矿十分在行，因此，灰矮人和矮人之间的关系，依旧十分融洽。”
“哦？灰矮人挖矿很厉害？”文森心中大喜，当真是瞌睡遇上枕头，他还在考虑怎么将绝魔金属挖出来，毕竟那玩意能够有效的阻隔魔力、斗气，因此只能依靠手工，一铲一铲的挖。
“嗯，灰矮人会挖矿，整个克伦蒂亚世界都知道。”
“把你们抓住的那个灰矮人带上来！”
克索斯走后，文森喃喃自语道：“有趣的种族！希望也是识趣的种族！”
绝魔金属对于他的计划，起着关键的作用。如果灰矮人能够主动帮他挖矿，他不介意付出一些代价。
如果不愿意，那就只能发动种族战争了！

没等多久，一个身高不过一米二，皮肤灰白色，外貌与正常人类无二的小矮人被带了进来。
文森吃着魔武世界中带来的紫葡萄，瞥了一眼那个小矮人。
“文森少爷，这就是被我们抓住的灰矮人。当时，我们改造荒山的时候，他企图搞破坏，才被我们抓了个现行！”土系大魔导师雷恩－厄斯踹了一脚小矮人，将他踢倒在地。
雷恩－厄斯是一个中年男人，因为厌恶了刀口舔血的生涯，加上奇迹之城聘请的报酬高，于是加入了文森的小团体。
“哼！”被踢到在地的小矮人冷哼一声，凶恶的看着文森。
文森饶有兴趣的看了看这个小矮人，吞了一颗葡萄后，才道：“这就是灰矮人？”
雷恩－厄斯讨好道：“是的，是的，这就是灰矮人。”
“灰矮人，你叫什么名字？”文森看着灰矮人的眼睛道。
灰矮人扭过头，显得十分不合作。
“灰矮人，你叫什么名字？我不想再问第三遍，如果你不回答，我就让小黑吃了你！”文森戏谑道。
躺在地上的暗黑魔龙抬起头来，脑袋从二楼阳台边露出来，漆黑的眼球中露出一抹凶光。
被绑着的灰矮人瑟瑟发抖，断断续续道：“我...我...叫....艾克......”

content_en:
Volume 1 Miracles of the Wasteland FS017 Mountain Bike Season Ideas
Six Hundred Flywheel in the West of the Sin City, a two-story modern villa is located in the middle of the mountain.
On the balcony on the second floor, Vincent was half lying on a lounge chair. In front of him, a purple ball of light appeared. This light ball is like a holographic projection. In the light ball, a lifelike city appears.
Vincent flipped his finger over the light ball and clicked. The image of the light ball immediately enlarged, and detailed pictures of the city appeared, along with accompanying architectural drawings.
This ball of light was created by combining knowledge of alchemy, magic patterns, and architecture. Among them, the knowledge of architecture is of course the team of master architects from Sin City!
"Butler Xos, are all the people in Sin City here?" Vincent put away the ball of light and handed it to Xos and asked.
Xosos was dressed in black robes, holding a one-meter-long staff in his right hand. A few sparks of lightning flashed from the top of the staff from time to time, and the aura on his body was a bit stronger than when he had just recovered.
"Master Vincent, all the magicians and warriors in Sin City are basically here, and there are still some ordinary people who are migrating. I have arranged for a great magister and a war master to lead some professional personnel to accompany them to ensure the safety of ordinary people. In addition, the earth mage is already building the city foundation and underground pipe network." Xosos took a list and reported one by one.
"By the way, Master Vincent, during the construction of the city's underground pipe network, we discovered the dark elves. After you subdued the dark dragon, they returned to the underground city. However, they hurriedly evacuated when they saw us, and there was no conflict."
"In addition, when we were transforming the barren mountain, we captured a gray dwarf." Xosus glanced at Vincent and saw that he had no expression. He continued: "The transformation of the barren mountain that you ordered, Master Vincent, has been nearly completed after seven days, and only the last few details remain."
"Oh? So fast?" Vincent sighed in his heart. Magical power indeed surpassed technological power in some places.
For example, in this barren mountain reconstruction, he plans to build a road from the bottom of the barren mountain around the mountain. If it were like a technological society, this would definitely be a grand project.
However, the earth magician in the magical power can quickly complete the task of building the road.
Among the earth magics, there is magic that is specialized in smoothing and solidifying roads, and it has been developed for tens of thousands of years. The ability of earth magicians to build roads is very powerful!
The two-hundred-wheel mountain road was completed in just one week!
This mountain road was an important idea used by Vincent to develop the city. The magic technology in the world of Crentia is very backward, almost primitive.
Vincent happened to discover a special kind of magic metal in these barren mountains, so he came up with a wonderful idea to hold a mountain motorcycle race in another world.
And, develop mountain bike racing into an annual event, just like it was in previous generations of technological societies!
"Master Vincent, because only roads need to be built and no other buildings are needed, the magicians are building it very quickly. However, Master Vincent, please forgive me for asking. There is nothing on that barren mountain and no one will go there. Why build roads?" Xosos finally couldn't help but ask the questions in his heart.
Vincent looked at the mountain with the magic metal hidden in it and smiled mysteriously, "Butler Xos, you will know after a while!"
"But..." Xosos wanted to ask again.
"Okay, Steward Xos!" Vincent stood up from the recliner, walked to the guardrail, lay down on the guardrail, and looked at the city under construction not far away.
"Butler Xos, do you believe in miracles?" Vincent asked casually.
Xos thought for a while, "Master Vincent, do you believe in miracles?"
"Hahahaha!" Vincent laughedstand up.
Pointing at the city under construction, he said confidently: "Butler Xos, I don't believe it!"
After a pause, a shocking mood suddenly surged from his body, "But, I can create miracles!"
"Steward Xos, our city is called - the City of Miracles!"
"City of Miracles...City of Miracles..." Xosos muttered a few words, his mind constantly recalling everything after meeting Vincent. First, he restored his magic power, then he forced the mythical powerhouse to retreat, and now he built a city in the wilderness plain. Isn't all of this a miracle?
As he thought about it, Xos suddenly felt as if he was decades younger, full of passion and energy. He wanted to witness the rise of a city, wanted to be written into an epic along with the City of Miracles, and wanted to perform a legend that would last forever with the City of Miracles!
"City of Miracles!" Xoxos shouted.
Vincent glanced at him with a smile, then turned to look at the City of Miracles. He knew that from now on, Xosos would be completely connected to the City of Miracles, connected to him, and would become his lifelong steward.
"Butler Xos, what does that gray dwarf do?" In the world of magic and martial arts, there is a race of dwarves. This race is characterized by being short and strong, and they are very knowledgeable in forging.
With a smile of excitement and anticipation, Xosos replied: "The gray dwarves are a branch of the dwarf race. Due to their dark constitution, the gray dwarves are not good at forging. Over time, they separated from the dwarf race and became an independent race. However, because the gray dwarves are very good at mining, the relationship between the gray dwarves and the dwarves is still very harmonious."
"Oh? Gray dwarves are very good at mining?" Vincent was overjoyed. He felt sleepy on his pillow. He was still thinking about how to dig out the magic metal. After all, that thing can effectively block magic power and fighting spirit, so he could only rely on manual digging, shovel after shovel.
"Well, gray dwarves know how to mine, and the entire world of Crentia knows that."
"Bring up the gray dwarf you captured!"
After Xos left, Vincent murmured to himself: "An interesting race! I hope it is also an interesting race!"
The magic metal plays a key role in his plan. If the gray dwarves could take the initiative to help him mine, he wouldn't mind paying some price.
If you don't want to, then you can only start a race war!
Not long after, a dwarf with a height of only 1.2 meters, gray-white skin, and an appearance that was no different from a normal human being was brought in.
Vincent ate the purple grapes he brought from Mowu World and glanced at the dwarf.
"Master Vincent, this is the gray dwarf we captured. At that time, when we were transforming the barren mountains, he tried to cause sabotage, and we caught him!" The great earth mage Ren-Eas kicked the dwarf and knocked him to the ground.
Ryan Erth is a middle-aged man who joined Vincent's small group because he was tired of the life of licking blood from the edge of a knife and the high salary from Miracle City.
"Hmph!" The dwarf who was kicked to the ground snorted coldly and looked at Vincent fiercely.
Vincent looked at the dwarf with interest. After swallowing a grape, he said, "Is this the gray dwarf?"
Ren-Eas said flatteringly: "Yes, yes, this is the gray dwarf."
"Gray dwarf, what's your name?" Vincent asked, looking into the gray dwarf's eyes.
The gray dwarf turned his head, looking very uncooperative.
"Gray dwarf, what's your name? I don't want to ask you a third time. If you don't answer, I'll let Xiao Hei eat you!" Vincent joked.
The dark dragon lying on the ground raised his head, and his head was exposed from the balcony on the second floor, with a fierce light in his dark eyeballs.
The tied gray dwarf shivered and said intermittently: "My...my...name...Ike..."
